summary.headline: Planetary Interventions and Transits
summary.text: Astrological rules for planetary interventions and transits: malefics, especially Mars and Saturn, afflict the Sun, Moon, and Jupiter through conjunctions, squares, diameters, stations, and angular placements, while benefics bring health, wealth, joy, and honors. The text distinguishes right-hand squares, trines, fixed-star contacts, restitutions, counter-restitutions, and age-related mitigation, with examples for diurnal and nocturnal nativities.
